title: Transport of existing etale factorization models to a later stage
statement: Let $I$ be a preorder, $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ any diagram, and $c$ any cone with apex $X$. Fix $i_0$, an affine etale $W$ over $D(i_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site], and families of etale objects $V_q$ over $X$, $U_q$ over $D(i_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with arrows $a_q:V_q\to p_{i_0}^*W$, $b_q:V_q\to p_{i_0}^*U_q$, indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. Write $B_j=p_j^*$, $F_j=(D(j\to i_0))^*$, and $e_j(Z):p_{i_0}^*Z\cong B_jF_jZ$ for the canonical comparisons. Given $j,k\in\mathrm{Over}(op\,i_0)$, an arrow $t:k\to j$, models $V_{j,q}$ and arrows $a_{j,q}$, $b_{j,q}$ to $F_jW$, $F_jU_q$, and isomorphisms $d_q:B_jV_{j,q}\cong V_q$ satisfying both limit arrow equations, put $P=(D(t.left))^*$. There exist arrows $a_{k,q}:PV_{j,q}\to F_kW$, $b_{k,q}:PV_{j,q}\to F_kU_q$, isomorphisms $d_{k,q}:B_kPV_{j,q}\cong V_q$, and $t_W:PF_jW\cong F_kW$, satisfying both corresponding limit arrow equations and $P(a_{j,q})\gg t_W=a_{k,q}$. This requires neither a limit condition on $c$, nor qcqs conditions, affineness of the models, directedness, or covering hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 01YZ; canonical fibre-product comparison and its associativity

proof.text: Construct the comparison Fk ≅ Fj ⋙ P and Bj ≅ P ⋙ Bk by MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp using D.map_comp, the Over-arrow equation, and cone naturality. Their inverses define ak, bk and dk.

For the associativity equation, substitute the three composition equalities and compare both projections into the fibre product. The pullback lift, pullback map, and pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso projection identities give equality. Naturality of the inverse Bj comparison then converts the two given arrow equations into the required equations. The displayed formula for ak is definitional. No covering is asserted.

theorem etale_factorizationData_baseChange
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (i₀ : I)
    (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).FullAffineEtale)
    (n : ℕ) (V : Fin n → c.pt.Etale)
    (a : ∀ q, V q ⟶
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj W.obj)
    (U : Fin n → (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    (b : ∀ q, V q ⟶
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj (U q)) :
    let B := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app j.left)
    let F := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map j.hom)
    let e := fun (j : Over (op i₀)) (Z : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤)
        (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom) (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom).symm).app Z
    ∀ (j k : Over (op i₀)) (t : k ⟶ j)
      (Vj : Fin n → (D.obj j.left).Etale)
      (aj : ∀ q, Vj q ⟶ (F j).obj W.obj)
      (bj : ∀ q, Vj q ⟶ (F j).obj (U q))
      (d : ∀ q, (B j).obj (Vj q) ≅ V q),
      (∀ q, (B j).map (aj q) ≫ (e j W.obj).inv = (d q).hom ≫ a q) →
      (∀ q, (B j).map (bj q) ≫ (e j (U q)).inv = (d q).hom ≫ b q) →
      let P := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map t.left)
      ∃ (ak : ∀ q, P.obj (Vj q) ⟶ (F k).obj W.obj)
        (bk : ∀ q, P.obj (Vj q) ⟶ (F k).obj (U q))
        (dk : ∀ q, (B k).obj (P.obj (Vj q)) ≅ V q)
        (tw : P.obj ((F j).obj W.obj) ≅ (F k).obj W.obj),
        (∀ q, (B k).map (ak q) ≫ (e k W.obj).inv = (dk q).hom ≫ a q) ∧
        (∀ q, (B k).map (bk q) ≫ (e k (U q)).inv = (dk q).hom ≫ b q) ∧
        (∀ q, P.map (aj q) ≫ tw.hom = ak q)
